title: Review decision-sets design against revised defaults-loop design
summary: Write docs/design/reviews/decision-sets-review-1.md, a review-only document. It checks decision-sets.md and the revised defaults-loop.md introspection step as one system, checks claims against code and records, checks Jev usage against POST /v1/evaluate, names the smallest first build, and ends with a verdict.

defaults_applied.how: Every finding cites the file or code path it was checked against; unmeasured numbers are labeled estimates.
The review is written for an outside reader.
Findings are checkable by a verifier reading the cited sources.
Review conventions are taken from the existing docs/design/reviews files.

assumptions: Review style follows the existing files in docs/design/reviews/.
The revised defaults-loop.md is already committed in the repository.
POST /v1/evaluate is described only in defaults-loop.md, so it is the reference for the Jev check.
The review is written as a stranger-readable document with findings ordered by severity.

acceptance_criteria.text: The review file exists at docs/design/reviews/decision-sets-review-1.md and no other design doc is edited.

It covers fit across four parts: introspection records, the defaults loop, typed decisions in sets, and failure signals that put a decision under review. Each gap is stated with a cited file or section.
Claims in both designs are checked against named code paths and records, each finding citing its source, with unverified items labeled.
A section checks Jev usage against the POST /v1/evaluate contract as the revised defaults-loop.md describes it, listing any mismatches.
It names one smallest first build that would prove the system on real records, with a concrete pass/fail observation.
It ends with exactly one verdict: accept, accept with changes (listed), or reject.
Numbers are measured or labeled as estimates, and the file has no secrets or personal data.
git status and git diff show only the new review file (and optionally CHANGELOG.md) changed; cargo fmt --check and cargo test still pass.

out_of_scope: Changing code, config, or governance files
departures: Slightly higher cost and time than the reference because the review reads two long designs plus code and records and checks an API contract.
